clf-avc-109.text: The cybersecurity committee of a retail network wants to review the security settings of the main corporate account of AWS. During the audit, it was found that the Root user does not have active access keys, has a complex password of 32 characters and has multifactor authentication (MFA) activated by physical token. According to best practices of AWS, what should be the operational destination of the credentials of this Root user from now on?
options: Share login data with junior support technical leaders to speed up responses to server crash incidents.
Maintain secure and isolated saved credentials, using the Root user exclusively for rare actions requiring account owner privileges.
Permanently delete the root user profile through the identity management console of IAM.
Use Root user login daily to encode software routines on serverless servers AWS Lambda.
clf-avc-109.explanation: Root user should be isolated and protected from daily operating routines. It should be accessed only for specific tasks that are inseparable (such as closing the account or changing business support plans).).
clf-avc-109.hint: After performing the initial setup and delegating administrative powers to secure identities created in IAM, the Root user must be armored and kept in strict custody.
optionRationales: Root user should be isolated and protected from daily operating routines. It should be accessed only for specific tasks that are inseparable (such as closing the account or changing business support plans).).
Sharing supreme user privilege credentials Root violates essential rules of compliance and global IT identity governance.
The Root user is the original irrefutable owner of the account AWS and its logical profile cannot be deleted from the infrastructure.
Employing the Root user for everyday engineering activities dramatically increases the risk of catastrophic leaks or accidental destructive errors in the corporate account.

clf-avc-110.text: A multinational adopts the AWS Organizations to control the IT infrastructure of its subsidiaries in different countries. By creating a new Organizational Unit (OU) called 'Environment-Production', the Solution Architect applied a Service Control Policy (SCP) containing an explicit denial filter (Deny) for the service Amazon DynamoDB. What will happen if the administrator of the IAM from one of the member accounts of this OR try to create a database table in DynamoDB?
options: The action will be immediately blocked with a denied access error, because the SCPs delimit maximum permissions and overlap with any local releases of the child account.
The table will be created successfully, since the logical privileges of the local administrators of the IAM of daughter accounts are sovereign in relation to the rules of the organization.
The creation request will generate a call for automatic financial billing directed to analysis of the technical support of AWS.
The Console of AWS Visually hide the bench DynamoDB of the screens of all the analysts of the daughter account, removing the logical functions of the panel.
clf-avc-110.explanation: The SCPs a denial (Deny) explicitly set up at the level of the Organisation necessarily cancels any release 'Allow' granted locally in the daughter accounts of the IAM.
clf-avc-110.hint: Centralised imperative rules set out in AWS Organizations act as the supreme governance guidelines of the holding in the cloud.
optionRationales: The SCPs a denial (Deny) explicitly set up at the level of the Organisation necessarily cancels any release 'Allow' granted locally in the daughter accounts of the IAM.
Local privileges are strictly subordinated to the guardians designed in the SCPs of the AWS Organizations, Making local administrators unable to circumvent global restrictions.
A AWS blocks the command at control plane level and rejects the call of API security immediately, without structuring automatic financial tickets in support.
The SCPs act by blocking security API calls in the backends and microservices of the cloud, keeping the standard catalog interface of the visual console unchanged.

clf-avc-111.text: A biotechnology startup uses an account AWS The audit team wants to ensure operational compliance and requires that every change made in the resources of the AWS IAM (as exclusion of users or annexation of policies) is recorded with historical accuracy and can be tracked by third-party security tools in real time. AWS generates and centralizes these log mutation events of the control plan?
clf-avc-111.explanation: The AWS CloudTrail records and monitors the history of API calls and transactions executed in the accounts. It captures events of modification of the IAM and allows to export logs for the S3 for analytical audits.
clf-avc-111.hint: Think of the component whose main pedagogical and compliance mission in the cloud AWS is register 'who executed which command, when and where'.
optionRationales: The AWS CloudTrail records and monitors the history of API calls and transactions executed in the accounts. It captures events of modification of the IAM and allows to export logs for the S3 for analytical audits.
The Trusted Advisor verify best practices in five pillars issuing advisory recommendations of current improvements, without acting as repository of analytical logs of real-time transactions.
The GuardDuty consumes logs to hunt active logical threats and intrusions using machine learning, but is not the primary tool in charge of structuring and issuing the track of API audit history.

The AWS Config records and tracks technical changes to the configuration status inventories of hardware and storage resources, different from the focus on historical events of administrative API calls from CloudTrail.

clf-avc-112.text: An international investment platform stores confidential logs in Amazon S3. A new compliance guideline requires that this data be protected against leakage at rest and that the cryptographic key used changes its internal cryptographic material to each 12 months automatically. However, for FinOps purposes, the team wants to avoid the monthly fixed cost of creating and maintaining customised customer keys. AWS KMS responds to this scenario?
options: Generate asymmetric keys via dedicated hardware using an isolated physical application of AWS CloudHSM.
Configure property keys to AWS (AWS owned keys) and associate a script in AWS Systems Manager to rotate them.
Use the managed keys of AWS (AWS managed keys) native service Amazon S3.
Provide a customer-managed key (Customer managed key) and enable automatic key rotation feature.
clf-avc-112.explanation: The keys managed from AWS (AWS managed keys) are automatically created for service by KMS, have no fixed cost of key storage and pass through continuous automatic rotation of cryptographic material annually by the provider itself.
clf-avc-112.hint: Evaluate the key type of the KMS which is service-specific, automated in rotations and 100% free for key custody.
optionRationales: The keys managed from AWS (AWS managed keys) are automatically created for service by KMS, have no fixed cost of key storage and pass through continuous automatic rotation of cryptographic material annually by the provider itself.
Although automatic annual rotation support, customer-managed keys (CMK) charge a fixed monthly rate per key created in KMS, violating the zero fixed cost requirement of the FinOps team.
Keys owned by the AWS (AWS owned keys) are of shared internal use of the provider and are not visible in KMS of the client, making it impossible to associate scripts or manage their policy locally.
The AWS CloudHSM provides dedicated and expensive cryptographic hardware instances in the cloud, which drastically contradicts the objective of cost optimization and removal of complex fixed costs.

clf-avc-113.text: During the annual conformity audit of a health operator in AWS, the auditors demanded immediate access to the formal reports of third parties that attest that the underlying infrastructure of physical servers meets the rigid standards of the ISO 9001 and SOC 3. What a native console resource AWS should be used by the governance sector to obtain and sign such documents on demand?
clf-avc-113.explanation: The AWS Artifact is the official self-service portal focused on the free download of security reports, external audits, compliance agreements and certifications of itself AWS.
clf-avc-113.hint: Focus on the security portal focused on providing 'artifacts' documental third party institutional compliance of the provider.
optionRationales: The AWS Artifact is the official self-service portal focused on the free download of security reports, external audits, compliance agreements and certifications of itself AWS.

The Audit Manager helps the customer to map and audit their own internal processes and cloud resources, but does not act as the repository for downloading the official audit reports of the infrastructure itself AWS.
The Trusted Advisor monitors the account in real time and issues operational and advisory recommendations for technical improvements, without storing international regulatory files or certificates.
OpsCenter centralizes operational work items (OpsItems) for engineers to investigate software and active infrastructure problems, without any relation to normative compliance.

clf-avc-114.text: A digital bank uses instances of Amazon EC2 to run financial APIs. To mitigate the risk of leaking mutual credentials, the security team wants that the data traffic that flows between customers and the Application Load Balancer is encrypted in transit by HTTPS with certificates SSL/TLS valid public, guaranteeing automatic and cost-free renewal. Which service acts by managing from end to end this life cycle of certificates?
clf-avc-114.explanation: The AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) deals with the provisioning, management, validation and renewal of digital certificates automatically and free of charge SSL/TLS public used with load balancers and distributions CloudFront.
clf-avc-114.hint: Think of the service whose only technical purpose is to issue and renew digital cryptographic signatures for cloud sites.
optionRationales: The AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) deals with the provisioning, management, validation and renewal of digital certificates automatically and free of charge SSL/TLS public used with load balancers and distributions CloudFront.
The AWS KMS manages cryptographic keys for encryption and protection of stored logical data at rest (such as data saved in volumes or newsletters), and non-cryptographic web browsing identities.
The Secrets Manager store logins, text secrets and confidential API keys with logical rotation capability, differing from certificate validation scope SSL/TLS global.
Security Hub centralizes security alerts and monitors the compliance position of internal account resources against market frameworks, without issuing web traffic keys.

clf-avc-115.text: An insurer wants to ensure continuous compliance and wants to be automatically alerted if any analyst accidentally removes the mandatory encryption of a pocket from the Amazon S3 or open rules SSH public Security Groups. The team needs to monitor these settings and evaluate the historical inventory against best practices. AWS must be hired?
clf-avc-115.explanation: The AWS Configur continuously monitors, records and evaluates configurations of the AWS. Your rules (Config Rules) immediately signal deviations and resources out of compliance with company guidelines.
clf-avc-115.hint: Identify the IT governance focused tool that records the history of changes to properties and hardware and storage settings in the account.
optionRationales: The AWS Configur continuously monitors, records and evaluates configurations of the AWS. Your rules (Config Rules) immediately signal deviations and resources out of compliance with company guidelines.

The CloudTrail captures and tracks the history of API call actions (who executed the command), but does not maintain a technical status compliance inventory of configurations or resource relationships.
The CloudWatch Logs centralizes text records generated by operating systems or application codes, without native visibility on structural compliance of resources AWS.

While alerting about problems of best practice, the Trusted Advisor does not store a detailed time line for changes in technical properties nor does it allow for the creation of custom IT compliance rules.

clf-avc-116.text: A mobile game startup wants to protect its application against volumetric denial of service attacks (DDoS) that attempt to exhaust the network band of its fora in the Layers 3 and 4. They want the basic level of protection that is natively activated, without additional cost and automatically for all infrastructure services of the AWS. What technical resource does the AWS They're taking advantage of it.?
clf-avc-116.explanation: The AWS Shield Standard is activated automatically and cost-free for all accounts of AWS, offering continuous protection against the most common and volumetric DDoS attacks that target the network and transport layers.
clf-avc-116.hint: This native infrastructure shield acts in an invisible way protecting the overall basic traffic of all corporate accounts of the AWS free of charge.
optionRationales: The AWS Shield Standard is activated automatically and cost-free for all accounts of AWS, offering continuous protection against the most common and volumetric DDoS attacks that target the network and transport layers.
The Shield Advanced is the corporate tariffed version that offers advanced mitigation, cost protection generated by peak attacks and dedicated access 24/7 to the DDoS response team (DRT) of AWS.
The AWS WAF is an application firewall focused on Layer 7 (web traffic inspection HTTP/HTTPS against malicious codes) and its use is charged, not activated free of charge by default.
The GuardDuty is a paid service for intelligent detection of logical threats based on machine learning that analyzes logs, and not an automatic DDoS network traffic barrier.

clf-avc-117.text: A corporate e-commerce portal wants to mitigate attempts of automated brute force attacks on your login screen HTTP. The team wants to create custom rules that contain the number of requests coming from the same IP and apply an automatic temporary lock if the IP exceeds 100 accesses in an interval of 5 minutes in the Layer 7. Which service provides this Rate-based Rules functionality natively?
clf-avc-117.explanation: The AWS WAF acts in the Layer 7 (application) inspecting web requests. Their rate-based rules (Rate-based Rules) track the volume of IP access in time windows, applying temporary automatic locks if limits are crossed.
clf-avc-117.hint: Remember the edge firewall of the AWS whose policies are configured to analyze and filter header and stream content HTTP Applications.
optionRationales: The AWS WAF acts in the Layer 7 (application) inspecting web requests. Their rate-based rules (Rate-based Rules) track the volume of IP access in time windows, applying temporary automatic locks if limits are crossed.
The Shield Standard protects network layers 3 and 4 against generic infrastructure DDoS attacks, without the ability to inspect or count logical path requests HTTP granular.
The NACLs function as firewalls statess at sub-network level and filter connections purely by static IPs or protocol ports, with no dynamic resources to count Layer web access rates 7.
The GuardDuty is an analytical service that signals anomalies and threats based on log history after occurrences, but does not act as an inline edge firewall to apply real-time fee rules.

clf-avc-118.text: A logistics multinational identified highly suspicious activities in its credentials and suspected that a key access (Access Key) to the IAM The security team needs an intelligent monitoring tool that evaluates account behavior and manages automated alerts of logical threats if users make API calls in impossible geographic locations. What service meets this detection of artificial intelligence anomalies?
clf-avc-118.explanation: The Amazon GuardDuty uses machine learning, detection of anomalies and integrated security intelligence feeds to analyze events of CloudTrail and alert about unusual logins, misuse of credentials or API calls from suspicious locations.
clf-avc-118.hint: Look for the security service that acts as a continuous cyber threat hunter actively analyzing telemetry and corporate log metadata.
optionRationales: The Amazon GuardDuty uses machine learning, detection of anomalies and integrated security intelligence feeds to analyze events of CloudTrail and alert about unusual logins, misuse of credentials or API calls from suspicious locations.

The Amazon Inspector performs automated static checks in search of vulnerabilities of outdated software codes and deviations of best practices within virtual servers, without monitoring global logical API behaviors.
The AWS Config records and tracks the historical inventory of logical changes to IT resource properties, without analyzing real-time malicious activities or intentions in API calls.
The Shield Advanced acts as a network volumetric shield against service denial attacks (DDoS) of external agents, unrelated to behavior or leakage of logical keys from IAM.

clf-avc-119.text: The compliance sector of a network of retail stores in AWS determined that, due to data security issues at rest, no volume of the Amazon EBS can be created in the account without encryption AES-256 In order to impose this rule, the company set up the AWS Configure to trigger an automatic remediation through playbooks from AWS Systems Manager whenever a vulnerable volume without encryption is detected. AWS Config classifies the status of a resource that hurts this rule?
clf-avc-119.explanation: Where an appeal assessed by the AWS Config does not meet the criteria and conditions stipulated by an active corporate configuration rule, it is formally marked in the panel as 'Non-compliant' (Not compliant).
clf-avc-119.hint: Focus on the standard term used in quality management and process audits to designate that an item has failed to meet a mandatory requirement.
optionRationales: Where an appeal assessed by the AWS Config does not meet the criteria and conditions stipulated by an active corporate configuration rule, it is formally marked in the panel as 'Non-compliant' (Not compliant).

The 'Not applicable' status occurs when the type of resource discovered by the scope of the inventory has no technical relation with the parameters of the evaluated rule (e.g., evaluating a bucket against a rule of instances) EC2).
This term is not part of the taxonomy of the operating states of AWS config; configuration deviations generate default logical compliance marks.
The official nomenclature adopted by the service uses exclusively binary concepts of compliance (Compliant or Non-Compliant) for audit governance purposes.

clf-avc-120.text: A manufacturing company is migrating data to Amazon S3 and you want to ensure maximum security for highly confidential data at rest. CISO established that the data encryption should be executed using logical keys controlled by the client in AWS KMS, allowing the company to decide on access policies and audit the use of each key by CloudTrail. options: Adopt property keys to the AWS (AWS owned keys) configured in Systems Manager Parameter Store.
Implement external symmetric encryption based on no AWS Artifact Enterprise.
Enable managed keys from AWS (AWS managed keys) native with cryptography SSE-S3.
Use Customer managed keys (Customer managed keys) on AWS KMS.

clf-avc-120.hint: Focus on the key type of KMS whose own name indicates that the life cycle and the governance of permissions reside under the ownership of the end-user.
optionRationales: Customer managed keys provide full user control over creation, usage policies, manual or automatic rotation, and call auditing API, fulfilling all severe corporate regulatory requirements.

The keys managed from AWS (AWS managed keys) are controlled in an invisible way by the provider itself and do not allow the client to manually alter or configure the logical policies of key permissions.
The AWS owned keys are used internally by AWS shared between multiple accounts and are not saved or visible in the catalog of KMS customer for local manipulation or audit.
The AWS Artifact acts in a purely advisory manner as a portal for downloading documents and static reports of institutional compliance, without active resources in file encryption.
